acceptance: No ModeCharDevice terminal predicate remains outside internal/term (guard test)
The two named tests pass using a real pty or an injected seam, not /dev/null
fix: Add a small pty test helper (or a terminal seam in each caller's deps), switch the three callers to term.IsTerminal, and rewrite the two tests to use the helper instead of /dev/null. Decide and document the /dev/null meaning once.
summary: Rank 38 added internal/term (ioctl IsTerminal, where /dev/null is not a terminal) and moved wake and evolve auth to it. Three older ModeCharDevice predicates remain, and they report /dev/null as a terminal: agentcmd/input.go:19, ship/verify.go:237 and phasecmd/phase_cycle.go:77. Moving them broke TestAgentRun_InputErrors and TestVerifyManualConfirmCoverfix_ConfirmationFollowsWhatTheOperatorTypes, which use /dev/null as a stand-in terminal. The phasecmd terminal-true branch needs a pty to cover.
title: One terminal predicate: agentcmd, ship and phasecmd use internal/term
